name: signature-light
notes: Gold / pink / ink in a masthead layout: a full-bleed gold masthead closed by a 3 px ink rule, then a cream page. Georgia for headlines and body, Consolas for labels and numbers (Georgia's old-style digits bounce). Pink is the masthead numeral only (display size; pink on gold 2.2, pink on cream 3.05) plus the hero's press ring and caption; accents on the cream page are gold, lines are ink. Contrast on cream: ink 16.8, secondary 7.8, muted 6.2. Chart tokens are the default palette, validated on white, not cream: use the default theme for data emails.
